description_en: Send a text message to the server. The digital human reads out the corresponding text and renders the video stream for the user
description_zh: 发送一个文本消息给到服务端，数字人播报对应的文本，并渲染视频流给到用户
kebab_example: aliyun avatar send-text --tenant-id 1 --session-id 5615 --text '纯文本：这是一段示例播报纯文本_SSML：SSML使用请参考官方文档' --unique-code 0000001000586737 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendText

parameters.help_en: Tenant ID, obtained from the digitized virtual human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: Session ID. Obtain it from the return value of the "Start a Digital Human" API
parameters.help_zh: 会话 SessionID。通过“启动一个数字人”API的返回值获取
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.example:
纯文本：这是一段示例播报纯文本
SSML：SSML使用请参考官方文档
parameters.help_en: Content of the text to be broadcast. Currently supports plain text and Alibaba Cloud Intelligent Speech Synthesis SSML (Speech Synthesis Markup Language). For details on using SSML, refer to the official documentation (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462017.html?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.37e9281fRBn9wz). The maximum text length is 1000 characters (excluding tags)
parameters.help_zh: 播报文本的内容，目前支持纯文本和阿里云智能语音合成的SSML标记语言（SSML使用方案请参考官方文档 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462017.html?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.37e9281fRBn9wz)），最大文本长度1000字（不包含标签）
parameters.name: text

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether this broadcast request interrupts the currently playing content. The default value is true
parameters.help_zh: 本次播报请求是否打断当前正在播报的内容，默认值为true
parameters.name: interrupt

parameters.help_en: Unique code for the broadcast request. Supports up to 64-bit and must be unique. You can use a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 播报请求唯一code，最大支持64位，需要保持唯一，可使用UUID
parameters.name: unique_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to send a callback notification when the digital human broadcasts this message. The default value is false. For more information, see Digital Human Callback Event Notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.37e9281fRBn9wz)
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要在数字人进行播报该条消息的时候进行回调通知，默认值false，具体可参考：数字人回调事件通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.37e9281fRBn9wz)
parameters.name: feedback

fields.help_en: Index of the current segment in streaming playback
fields.name: index

fields.help_en:
Segment position

start - The first starting segment  
mid - A middle segment  
end - The final ending segment
fields.help_zh:
片段位置

start - 第一个开始片段
mid - 中间的片段
end - 最后一个结束片段
fields.name: position

parameters.help_en: Extender object for streaming playback. If not using streaming playback, do not pass this object. The user must split the text into segments (for example, by punctuation marks), and the digital human will continuously read out the submitted text segments in order
parameters.help_zh: 流式播报扩展对象，不是流式播报，不传该对象。用户需要自己切分文本片段（比如说按照标点符号切分），数字人按照提交文本顺序连续的进行播报
parameters.name: stream_extension

Code.description_en: Code corresponding to the returned processing exception

Message.description_en: Description corresponding to the returned processing exception
Message.description_zh: 返回处理异常对应描述
